name: CI cache populate failing — poweredge-xubuntu repos_failed > 0 for an hour
description: Fires when MIN(livespec.ci_cache.populate.repos_failed) for host.name=poweredge-xubuntu over the trailing 60 min is above 0 — every tick in the window (≥2 populates at the 30-minute schedule) reported at least one failed repository step (uv sync, cargo pre-warm through the proxy, or the sccache writer build), so one routed repository is being served from a stale generation or an unfilled compilation cache. A single failed tick (a transient PyPI/crates.io hiccup) does not fire. Value trigger. Runbook: ssh poweredge-xubuntu; sudo kubectl -n ci-warm-cache logs job/$(sudo kubectl -n ci-warm-cache get jobs --sort-by=.metadata.creationTimestamp -o name | tail -1 | cut -d/ -f2) | grep -E 'FAILED|failed'; sudo cat /var/lib/rancher/k3s/storage/.warm/populate-manifest.json. Emitter: ci-runner/observability/ci-cache-gauges.sh from the populator's manifest (warm-cache-populate.sh). livespec-dev-tooling-gjqw2i, plan ci-runner-cache-tiers research/003 §Triggers.
